subject: bsz-judfmt FINDINGS (pinned #[ignore] in tests/jud.rs, re...
body:
bsz-judfmt FINDINGS (pinned #[ignore] in tests/jud.rs, reader untouched):
(1) judgment-bsz.18.20: a key spelled as a number and as quoted text (2024 vs "2024") is two YAML keys, one text key; the reader silently keeps the last: metadata.labels, spec.questions (a question dropped), a case state, expect, recording answers. Spec says a key is text and a duplicate is an error. Test: a_key_spelled_as_a_number_and_as_text_is_a_duplicate.
(2) judgment-bsz.18.20: any number key INSIDE a question (Choice criteria {1: poor, 2: fair}, instructions {1: ..}, part_when, a Score level object, Noul criterion object) is refused 'invalid type: integer, expected a string key' at the question's line; the schema takes all five and state {2024: x} is read. Cause: RawQuestion is internally tagged, so serde buffers it and the integer key never becomes text. Test: a_number_key_inside_a_question_is_read_as_text.
(3) judgment-bsz.16.10: a case's supplied options are read through serde_json::Value (jud::some), so without preserve_order (the shipped jud binary, no mcp) they come back sorted: the order the model sees changes. --all-features hides it (mcp turns preserve_order on). Test: supplied_options_are_read_in_the_order_written; run with cargo test --features jud --test jud -- --ignored. part_when goes through the same path.
None is a one-line contract-free fix, so not fixed.

subject: reader key semantics changed (w2-reader 343d2f9): a key i...
body: reader key semantics changed (w2-reader 343d2f9): a key is its written text. Refused now: 2024 and "2024" in one map (duplicate, Error::Syntax). Kept as two keys: 01 and 1. Read now: number keys inside a question (criteria, instructions, part_when, Score level object, Noul criterion). Wrong criteria shape for a question type is Error::Invalid at spec.questions.<id>.criteria rather than Syntax. Schemas unchanged; a reader/schema agreement property should treat number-vs-text duplicate keys as reader-refused (JSON Schema cannot see them).
